integrity: The proof uses the published characteristic equation and an exact mixed-boundary spectral reduction. Existence, uniqueness and transversality at zero advection are analytic; numerical bisection is used only to display one representative point and is independently replayed by the included script.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local spectral double-Hopf existence theorem near small advection. It does not compute the nonlinear double-Hopf normal form, classify the local unfolding, or determine the largest advection interval on which the continued intersections exist.
title: Positive-advection double Hopf points in the delayed strong-Allee model
